Duplex 1 Bed | Furnished | Upgraded | EMAAR

haus & haus proudly presents this rare one-bedroom duplex unit in Marina Promenade, offering an expansive layout and refined turnkey interiors within one of Dubai Marina’s most desirable waterfront communities. 

This exceptional home features striking double-height ceilings, light-filled open-plan living and dining areas and a generously proportioned bedroom designed for both comfort and style. This 1,422 sq. ft, accommodation offers the same generous square footage as a premium 2-bedroom apartment in this community. 

The property has undergone extensive, high-end renovations, including a double sized master bathroom and the addition of a second full bathroom, ensuring maximum utility for residents & guests. The integrated Murphy bed adds an extra layer of versatility, allowing the living space to transition to a comfortable guest suite. Seamlessy blends privacy, sophistication, and luxury waterfront living. 

Amazing Amenities.

Security deposit - 10%
